response.sql: WITH category_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)) AS avg_cost_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), category_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference FROM category_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference) AS average_cost_difference, AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference - cm.mean_cost_difference) AS average_excess FROM category_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm WHERE ca.avg_cost_difference > cm.mean_cost_difference;
